name: 72802 · Russellville, AR
findings: ZIP 72802 (Russellville) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (18%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72802 (Russellville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
